title: High Resolution Imaging Mass Spectrometry Analysis using Bruker Daltonics Platforms
author: Elizabeth Neumann
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7gdhjs6

steps.title: Load slide adapter plate
steps.instruction: Insert the MTP slide adapter plate containing the matrix‑coated tissue section into the instrument airlock and press “load.”

steps.title: Scan tissue section image
steps.instruction: Scan a 3200 dpi image of the matrix‑coated tissue section in the MTP slide adapter 2, ensuring sufficient contrast to visualize the tissue boundaries.

steps.title: Select height‑correct method
steps.instruction: Choose a acquisition method that has “height correct” initiated upon sample docking.

steps.title: Configure FlexImaging while profiling
steps.instruction: While the height‑correct profile is being generated, open FlexImaging and follow the prompts to designate the sample file name, select the chosen method, set the pitch, and load the scanned image of the slide.

substeps.instruction: Load the 3200 dpi scanned image of the slide.

steps.title: Train target position
steps.instruction: Once the height‑correct profile has been generated, train the target position by placing three teaching points as instructed within FlexImaging.

steps.title: Define measurement region
steps.instruction: Draw a measurement region around the tissue to be used for IMS analysis.

steps.title: Verify laser focus
steps.instruction: Move to an area off the tissue and ensure the laser focus is adequate for 10 µm spatial‑resolution imaging.
